endpoints.name: marketplace_getcharges
endpoints.description: Get all wallet charges [GET /marketplace/billing/charges] Token: location. Scopes: charges.readonly.

meterId.description: Billing Meter ID (you can find this on your app's pricing page on the developer portal)

userId.description: Filter results by User ID that your server passed via API when the charge was created

startDate.description: Filter results AFTER a specific date. Use this in combination with endDate to filter results in a specific time window.

endDate.description: Filter results BEFORE a specific date. Use this in combination with startDate to filter results in a specific time window.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return

endpoints.name: marketplace_charge
endpoints.description: Create a new wallet charge [POST /marketplace/billing/charges] Token: location. Scopes: charges.write.

meterId.description: Billing Meter ID (you can find this on your app's pricing page)

eventId.description: Event ID / Transaction ID on your server's side. This will help you maintain the reference of the event/transaction on your end that you charged the customer for.

locationId.description: ID of the Sub-Account to be charged

companyId.description: ID of the Agency the Sub-account belongs to

eventTime.description: The timestamp when the event/transaction was performed. If blank, the billing timestamp will be set as the event time. ISO8601 Format.

endpoints.name: marketplace_getspecificcharge
endpoints.description: Get specific wallet charge details [GET /marketplace/billing/charges/{chargeId}] Token: location. Scopes: charges.readonly.

chargeId.description: ID of the charge to retrieve

endpoints.name: marketplace_deletecharge
endpoints.description: Delete a wallet charge [DELETE /marketplace/billing/charges/{chargeId}] Token: location. Scopes: charges.write.

chargeId.description: ID of the charge to delete

endpoints.name: marketplace_hasfunds
endpoints.summary: Check if account has sufficient funds
endpoints.description: Check if account has sufficient funds [GET /marketplace/billing/charges/has-funds] Token: location. Scopes: charges.readonly.

endpoints.name: marketplace_get_installer_details
endpoints.description: Get Installer Details Fetches installer details for the authenticated user. This endpoint returns information about the company, location, user, and installation details associated with the current OAuth token. [GET /marketplace/app/{appId}/installations] Token: location or agency. Scopes: marketplace-installer-details.readonly.

appId.description: ID of the app to get installer details

endpoints.name: marketplace_uninstall_application
endpoints.description: Uninstall an application Uninstalls an application from your company or a specific location. This will remove the application`s access and stop all its functionalities [DELETE /marketplace/app/{appId}/installations] Token: location or agency. Scopes: oauth.write.

appId.description: The application id which is to be uninstalled.

companyId.description: The company id from which the application is to be uninstalled. If you pass agency token, then companyId is required. It will uninstall application from agency as well as all sub-accounts.

locationId.description: The location id from which the application is to be uninstalled. If you pass location token, then locationId is required. It will uninstall application from that location only.

reason.description: The reason for uninstalling the application. Reason is required if you are uninstalling the application as a developer.

endpoints.name: marketplace_get_rebilling_config_for_app
endpoints.summary: Get rebilling config for an app subscription and usage plans
endpoints.description: Get rebilling config for an app subscription and usage plans for the authenticated sub-account. This endpoint returns the subscription and usage plans for an app. [GET /marketplace/app/{appId}/rebilling-config/location/{locationId}] Token: location. Scopes: oauth.readonly.

appId.description: ID of the app to get rebilling config

locationId.description: ID of the Sub-Account location to get rebilling config for

endpoints.name: marketplace_migrateconnection
endpoints.description: Migrate external authentication connection Migrates an external authentication connection credentials (basic or oauth2) for a specific app and location. This endpoint validates the app configuration, stores credentials safely in CRM's native encrypted storage. With this the lifecycle of the token is managed by CRM. [POST /marketplace/external-auth/migration] Token: location. Scopes: marketplace-external-auth-migration.write.

type.description: Type of authentication - basic or oauth2

apiKey.description: API Key (supported when type is basic)

basicCredentials.description: Basic auth credentials as key/value pairs (supported when type is basic). Keys are validated against the app version externalAuthConfig.fields.

accessToken.description: Access token (required when type is oauth2)

refreshToken.description: Refresh token (required when type is oauth2)

expiryIn.description: Access token expiry time in milliseconds (optional for oauth2)

expiryAt.description: Timestamp for access token expiry (optional for oauth2)

displayName.description: Display name for the connection (optional, defaults to accountId)

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default connection for the location (optional, defaults to false)
